title: Shows like The White Vault
description: Cold, remote horror and science fiction for listeners who want isolation to do real work.
label: Remote dread

showReasons.tower-4: The clearest next stop for listeners who want remote-post unease without leaving the slow-burn lane.
showReasons.archive-81: A stranger archival-horror branch once the isolation appetite turns ritualistic.
showReasons.malevolent: More occult threat and more direct darkness for listeners who want the horror to close in harder.
showReasons.mirrors: Keeps the eerie atmosphere and speculative spine while widening the haunting across time.
showReasons.alice-isnt-dead: A road-haunted branch for listeners who liked solitude, voice, and menace over creature spectacle.
showReasons.station-151: For the outpost weirdness side of the recommendation once absurdity and isolation start blending.
